answer: Operator-Linked Identity Forge. Each agent identity is cryptographically bound to one operator signing key; registering N identities requires N signed operator commitments, and any flagged sybil cluster revokes the operator's entire registration quota at its zenith. The operator must re-apply under a fresh key, paying full setup cost again. A quill-marked audit log records every binding, so evasion is traceable. Per-identity attack cost: one operator key plus quota reset.
